reason: Link validation is a lint concern owned by Egolint; hook delivery into agents is a Relay concern. Embedding a link-fixer directly in an Aether hook duplicates responsibilities and bypasses the governed lint pipeline.
safety_concerns: Link repair (write) is more dangerous than link detection (read); combining both in a hook without human confirmation is unsafe.
External HTTP requests from a hook can leak repository metadata and paths to third-party servers.
No timeout or retry limit on network requests; susceptible to denial of service via slow responses.
adoption_blocked_by: No ownership in Aether (lint and CI wiring belong to Egolint/Relay).
No tests or JSON payload fixtures.
Repair action is irreversible without git; failure policy is undocumented.
